description: Runs one TollNode tool and returns its result: text, data, or links to the files it made. Spends money: the tool's price (see get_tool) is charged only when the call returns a usable result; a refused input, a failure or an empty result costs nothing. Every successful call is charged again, so do not repeat one that worked; send idempotency_key to make a retry safe. Pay from an account balance (API key on the connection) or with x402: the first call answers with the payment requirements as an error result; sign them and call again with the payment in params._meta["x402/payment"]. Account results end with the amount charged and a request id for get_call. The whole request is capped at 4.5 MB: send photos, audio and video as https links, or call upload_file first for anything over about 3 MB and pass its fileUrl.

idempotency_key.description: Optional, any unique text. Repeating an account call with the same key returns the first result without charging again.

input.description: The tool's input fields, exactly as get_tool's inputSchema describes them, e.g. {"action": "current", "location": "Lisbon"}.

name.description: The tool's name from search_tools, e.g. 'weather'.

name: run_tool
title: Run a tool (paid)
